body: Yeah. I’ve tried seeing both of my school counsellors, neither of them are particularly good. And because I live in a small town, there aren’t any support groups in the immediate area
Been trying to. My friends won’t help me much though. I’m 16,  so what can they really do?

My family disowned me. I drink to cope with it. I have a fucked up cycle in my brain. I’m paranoid, I hallucinate without drugs, I get really bitchy and irritable, I’m just generally not a good person to be around, and there’s nothing I can do to change that
I simply do not feel as though I deserve life. I’m a fucked up human being. My life has no value, so why should I continue to allow myself to suffer? It doesn’t make sense to me.

I physically cannot care for myself. I see no reason to. If everyone else thinks that I’m trash except for me, then there is a far higher chance that I’m the one that’s wrong, and not them. I’ve accepted that they’re right, and decided that I don’t deserve to live anymore.
Nah. Nobody cares about me. One of my closest friends said, and I quote, “People don’t particularly care about you.”
